title: How I Built Signal Brief With Coding Agents
dek: I used one agent to build another, W&B Inference to run its model pipeline, and Weave traces to turn runtime failures into concrete engineering decisions.

content_pillar.name: How agent engineers work
content_pillar.promise: Learn what credible practitioners are actually doing.
content_pillar.editorial_object: The practitioner's experience and judgment—not a company endorsement.

research_question: How did a practitioner use a coding agent, W&B Inference, and Weave to build a production-shaped research agent and turn runtime failures into concrete engineering decisions?
practitioner_thesis: Useful agents need two loops: one loop does the work, and another makes the work inspectable enough to improve safely.

product.name: Signal Brief
product.problem: Finding AI news was easy; deciding what deserved attention or original work was the bottleneck.
product.solution: Signal Brief turns source evidence into a small, inspectable decision queue.

surfaces.name: News
surfaces.purpose: Read five ranked stories with source links and why-they-matter context.

surfaces.name: Content
surfaces.purpose: Review at most three evidence-backed ideas, inspect missing proof, and explicitly approve or hand off work.

surfaces.name: Obsidian
surfaces.purpose: Preserve the larger evidence pool, research memory, and decisions locally.

surfaces.name: Widget
surfaces.purpose: Expose a read-only, credential-free summary without making model calls.

product.human_boundary: The models propose ranked stories and opportunities; the practitioner reviews evidence and explicitly decides what moves forward.

synthesis.role: Connect bounded evidence into ResearchMapV1, ranked stories, and editorial opportunities.

briefing.role: Produce an explicit content brief only when the user requests it.

safeguards: One selected provider per run with no silent provider fallback.
Structured model output is validated and treated as untrusted.
Stable source identities are checked before display.
Scheduled research runs may call the configured provider automatically; content-brief generation, publishing, and GitHub handoffs remain explicit user actions.
The widget is read-only and excludes credentials and private research state.

development_roles.responsibility: Define the product problem, trust boundaries, acceptable behavior, and what is worth shipping.
Inspect the repository, implement changes, run tests, and validate the installed application.
Run the recurring collection, triage, synthesis, memory, and delivery workflow.
Record the runtime prompts, responses, latency, errors, and validation boundary.

weekly_runs.research_map_outcome: timeout followed by grounded deterministic fallback
weekly_runs.observed_failure: The single 120B research-map request exceeded five minutes after receiving an oversized evidence prompt.
weekly_runs.engineering_change: Bound trailing evidence and novelty context rather than sending the full historical pool.

weekly_runs.research_map_outcome: model response captured; validator exposed schema-label and identity defects during replay
weekly_runs.observed_failure: The structured response echoed trendIndex:0 into prose, contained duplicate trusted IDs, and attached display copy to the wrong trusted source identity.
weekly_runs.engineering_change: Replay the captured response locally; repair only exact schema echoes, dedupe trusted identities, and replace mismatched display copy from the trusted source record.

weekly_runs.research_map_outcome: timeout followed by grounded deterministic fallback
weekly_runs.observed_failure: A smaller but still large prompt again exceeded five minutes.
weekly_runs.engineering_change: Compress the prompt below a tested 50,000-character ceiling while retaining 40 balanced current candidates.

weekly_runs.research_map_outcome: validated structured ResearchMapV1 with no receipt warnings
weekly_runs.engineering_change: The bounded prompt, validator, and trusted-display repairs produced the intended weekly map.

field_run.triage_note: The run rebuilt the weekly map from 245 cached evidence items, so no new per-item triage calls were required during this receipt.

development_changes.evidence: 107k characters and repeated five-minute endpoint timeouts
development_changes.change: Keep 40 balanced current candidates while reducing recent evidence and novelty history; add a prompt-size regression below 50k.

development_changes.problem: Structured output contained schema vocabulary as content
development_changes.evidence: trendIndex:0 appeared where an opportunity thesis belonged
development_changes.change: Reject invalid structured output generally, but repair only the exact known schema echo from grounded expectedValue.

development_changes.problem: Trusted identities and display text drifted apart
development_changes.evidence: Duplicate trusted IDs and a headline bound to the wrong source ID
development_changes.change: Dedupe known IDs, continue rejecting unknown IDs, and restore title/summary from the trusted source record when display copy mismatches.

development_changes.problem: The Content screen hid valid work
development_changes.evidence: The app opened daily context, defaulted to a Pitch-only filter, and vertically centered a clipped empty state
development_changes.change: Open the weekly research context, show all populated recommendations, and validate the installed native app after the code tests.

practitioner_lessons: Give cheap triage and expensive synthesis different jobs.
Treat structured model output as untrusted input.
Preserve stable evidence identities all the way to the UI.
Trace the boundary where source evidence becomes a decision.
Replay captured responses locally before paying for another model call.
Keep expensive or external actions explicit and human-controlled.
limitations: This is a production engineering field report, not a controlled benchmark of coding-agent productivity or a causal comparison of observability tools.

The four receipts record top-level success because deterministic fallback is a successful product outcome; the research-map timeout and validation incidents are reconstructed from contemporaneous development notes and code changes.

Historical Weave conversation IDs and project identities are preserved in the receipts, but exact call URLs could not be reconstructed because the current Calls query returned no rows; every historical run is therefore labeled receipt-only, and prompt bodies, tokens, and costs are omitted.
Prompt-character counts are rounded from contemporaneous trace inspection and are marked approximate.
Later runs still show timeout and fallback behavior, so the iteration fixed specific boundaries without eliminating model or provider variability.
